[package]
name = "tether-search-provider"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true

publish = false

[dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"

regex = "1"

[dev-dependencies]

tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread", "time"] }

[lints]
workspace = true
